4336-5006-5686-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-5686-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

2793-3129-3743-5089-8242.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-5089-8242.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Songbird by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

527-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Selvala has a +1/+1 counter on it.
527-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-4613-4687.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G/U}.
Activate Selvala using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
1322-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4694-6258-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-6258-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
4694-6258-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3991-4247-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1456-3899-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-3899-4871-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-3967-4153--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

4985-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

348-1152-3191-6112-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-6112-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Fumulus triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5359-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3738-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
3738-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Sightless Ghoul.
Sightless Ghoul dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sightless Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Sightless Ghoul, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

457-944-1458-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-944-1458-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

117-1618-2440-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Talrand
117-1618-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
117-1618-2440-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Talrand. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2906-4217-7101.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4217-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Rakdos.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
You control another Merfolk and/or Knight.
3532-4668-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and Knight you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1409-1418-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve both Kalain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4200-4681-5256.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

933-1305-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
933-1305-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

3875-5702-6763-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5702-6763-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-2034-2122-3334.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-3334.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

56-789-5256-6112.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-5256-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Fumulus and Gutter Grime trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-5256-6112.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

719-4508-4772-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

618-3967-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1116-2842-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-2842-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Blood Artist and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Blood Artist and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1909-2436-4486.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness. Marwyn has power 4 or greater and has at least a +1/+0 boost from secondary effects.
1909-2436-4486.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat.
1909-2436-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

4624-5878-5879.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus (one plus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive).
4624-5878-5879.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}, doubling your life total and causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Cradle of Vitality triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to put a number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive equal to the life you gained.
At the beginning of the next upkeep, Walking Archive triggers, causing the active player to draw cards equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
If the player attempts to draw from an empty library, they lose the game.
If they didn't lose the game, the player will attempt to draw a card during their draw step and lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.

338-678-2060-2123-2438.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have at least two opponents.
338-678-2060-2123-2438.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kokusho.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

337-934-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real and Amorphous Axe attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-934-4222-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

1722-1926-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Tentacle.
"Tentacle" chosen with Species Specialist.
1722-1926-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {1}.
The Tentacle dies, triggering Species Specialist, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
